title: Limit public authentication requests
responsibility: Count selected POST requests in a per-address, per-route one-minute database window.

inputs.name: hubRateLimit.input
inputs.type: { request: Request; db?: D1Database; secret?: string; ip?: string; now?: number; }
inputs.description: Request plus optional database, secret, client IP and epoch-millisecond clock. Missing database/secret bypasses limiting; absent IP uses local and absent time uses Date.now().

outputs.name: hubRateLimit
outputs.description: Null for unlisted/non-POST routes or requests within the cap; otherwise 429 rate-limited with Retry-After 60. Counts are updated using a keyed hash of IP and path, never the raw IP. Caps are 5 for email sends, 20 for Google sign-in, 60 for native polling and 10 for other listed auth/host-registration routes.
